finding.description: The new adapter cannot construct any of the four inspected 1.2B variants unchanged.
finding.trigger: Build a model from any inspected 1.2B configuration, where sliding_window_pattern is null and there is more than one layer. Omitting the key has the same effect; explicitly supplying an empty string instead reaches modulo zero.
finding.expected_behavior: Handle the absent schedule explicitly, or reject it with an architecture-specific configuration diagnostic.
finding.actual_behavior: The pattern defaults to None and the layer-0 expression calls len(None), before any decoder blocks or the head are built. An empty string reaches idx % 0. Model.from_config is the generic constructor dispatch; conversion's get_base_model is one higher-level caller.

verification.description: Ran the extracted reader and the scalar layer predicate with the pinned values and an empty-pattern case.
verification.limits: No model construction or tensor loading was run.
